name: Yuki Sato
bio: Yuki Sato (佐藤 祐基, Satō Yūki, February 22, 1984) is a Japanese actor from Shinagawa, Tokyo. He was also used the stage names of Tomohito Satō (佐藤 智仁, Satō Tomohito) and Jin Satō (佐藤 汛, Satō Jin). He is affiliated with Ever Green Entertainment since March 2010. He used to belong to the top coat.
